info.title: Communication Legacy API v2
info.description: Legacy v2 API endpoints for communication domain (conversations and messages)

post.summary: Share a document with the client
post.description:
## Overview
Shares a document that is already on a matter with the matter's client. The document becomes visible to the client, and a new document message is added to the matter's conversation. The client gets an email unless `shared_with_email` is false. When the client has no email address, no email is sent and the request still succeeds.

The message has no custom text. The document stays on its own matter.

Do not use it for a document that the client sent (`direction` is `client_to_business`): the call changes its direction to business-to-client.

The staff member must own the document, have organization access, or collaborate on the client.

Available for **Staff tokens**.

parameters.description: The UID of the document to share (e.g., "k2v8qz1m9xw3rt5p").
parameters.name: uid

shared_with_email.description: When true or omitted, the client also gets an email (e.g., true, false).

403.description: Forbidden. The staff member may not share this document.

404.description: Not Found. The document does not exist in this business.

get.description:
## Overview
Retrieves a paginated list of messages within a specific conversation. Messages are returned in chronological order and include staff details, document attachments, and delivery status.

Available for **Staff and Directory tokens**. Directory tokens require the `X-On-Behalf-Of` header with the target business UID.

parameters.description: The unique identifier (UID) of the conversation to retrieve messages from.
parameters.name: conversation_id

parameters.description: How many items to return per page. Default: 20
parameters.name: per_page

parameters.description: If set, returns only messages updated in the last minute. Useful for polling for new messages.
parameters.name: last_update

parameters.description: When set to 'me', filters messages to only those visible to the current staff member's team view.
parameters.name: teams_view_filter

parameters.description: Business UID to act on behalf of. Required for Directory tokens.
parameters.name: X-On-Behalf-Of

200.description: Success - Returns an array of message objects.

application/json.text: Hi, this is a sample message.
application/json.title: Sample conversation
application/json.subject: Sample conversation

404.description: Not Found - Conversation does not exist.

Bearer.description: Provide a valid bearer token in the Authorization header. Example: 'Authorization: Bearer {app_token}'
